native_settle_tail_note: 2026-11-09: run console_109d62b7b1bf4034858d643596aeecb8 completed the whole 230 mm lift and then the installed supervised sender raised 'final feedback mismatch'. Disassembly of /home/yikun/ares-r-curobo-assets/jaka_right_supervised_path_v6_pick shows it takes ONE feedback read right after the last sample and throws when any joint is more than 0.05 deg (0.000872665 rad) off the last target. At the 0.2 rad/s ceiling the cubic-retimed lift still carried 0.42 deg/s at its last sample and the servo was 0.217 deg behind (contact, at 0.05 rad/s, was only 0.028 deg; the legacy-resampled pregrasp ends with a stationary tail and was 0.005 deg). The packager now repeats the final commanded pose for 10 cycles (0.8 s) after every segment: same endpoint, same samples, no extra motion, and the sender's own validator already accepts zero-velocity rows. Set to 0 to disable. demo-local: only the demo2 entry points pass --settle-tail, so demo3 keeps its byte-identical native files.

quality_num_trajopt_seeds_note: 2026-11-09 demo-local QUALITY seed override. bounded_interpolation_buffer() indexes seeds*spheres*cuboid_capacity in int32: with 8 seeds x 1647 spheres x 768 cuboid capacity the cap is floor((2^31-1)*0.9/10.1e6)=190 steps, but the tcp3/no-bias pregrasp path needs 361, so every QUALITY attempt failed with 'Interpolated trajectory requires 361 waypoints'. Four seeds raise the cap to ~382 (4*1647*768=5.06e6) without touching config/system.json, interpolation_dt or any validator. config/planner_latency_profiles.json and the shared QUALITY policy stay unchanged.
